name: Civilight Eterna
description: Does not attack but continuously restores the <@ba.kw>HP</> of all allies within range (the HP restored per second is equal to 10% of self ATK). Self is unaffected by <$ba.inspire>Inspiration</>

candidates.name: Dust of the Past
candidates.description: 3 Particles orbit Civilight Eterna at all times. When a Particle collides with an allied Operator, it disappears and increases Civilight Eterna's Trait effect on that Operator to 1.2x for 6s. The disappeared Particle respawns after 6s.

levels.name: The Future Elusive
levels.description: Particle limit <@ba.vup>+3</> and immediately gains <@ba.vup>{extra_cnt}</> Particles. Particle orbit radius expands, and all allies in attack range gain <$ba.inspire>Inspiration</> equal to <@ba.vup>{attack@atk:0%}</> of Civilight Eterna's ATK. Particles no longer collide with allied Operators, and instead deal <@ba.vup>{atk_scale:0%}</> of Civilight Eterna's ATK as True damage when colliding with an enemy unit, and also <$ba.root>Binding</> them for <@ba.vup>{unmoveable_duration}</>s.
